title: Formula 1 - TCDS
subtitle: Making Fast Faster
body:
#### The F1® TCDS (Team Content Delivery System) enables a synchronised video and audio view so Formula 1® teams can elevate their race strategy in near real-time.

If you ever watch a formula 1 race, you will always see team race engineers at a Pitwall. They are watching live video, listening to team audio and looking at car telemetry data. TCDS is the product that allows teams to see video feeds of all drivers and timing pages. Its a center piece of every race weekend.

## The Challenge

There was an existing product in place that was being used. Upon first inspection, the incumbent had a very confusing interface. Think overlays in overlays and hovers on top of hovers. Early 2000's UI. This poor user experience was also confirmed by the formula 1 teams who reported a lot of instability in the platform. 

Another key point was latency of the live feed. 12 seconds! So your team car has come flying past you on the track and you don't see it on video for 12 seconds! This was more of a technical challenge but needed to be improved drastically.

Then there was the lack of features. The incumbent did the basics. It didn't allow a lot any customisation to the user or create any unique experience at all.

## The Approach

We met all F1 Teams for user research, and for design playback. It was a challenging circumstance. Each different team wanted unique features but there was a clear consensus of the key features we needed to build.

When designing a video streaming platform, we wanted maximum adaptability for the user. Users could play 4 concurrent video streams at once. This helped devised the 'auto-layout' of the system screen where video sizes adjust dependant on how many videos are being played. Users could also save their layout which is their favourite set of streams so they can change views fast.

It was clear we needed to be fast. Fast meets fast. We devised a hot key system which allowed keyboard shortcuts to be performed for almost all actions on the platform. This greatly benefitted the current point and click mouse approach.

Been able to 'clip' moments from race days for debriefs and strategy meetings was an important need. We devised a sharing solution to accommodate this.

We went on a factory tour of all F1 teams. From UK to Switzerland to Austin. Spoke to the real life end-users who were positive and excited for our new product!

## The Outcome

**Acclaimed Usability and Visual Design:** Task performance dramatically increased paired with high amount of positive feedback

**Latency Reduction:** Dramatically reduced video and data latency from 12 seconds to under 5 seconds.

**Global Scalability:** Supporting 24 events around the world with over 7,500 hours of cataloged video.

**Operational Excellence:** Enabled engineers and strategists to make split-second decisions with higher confidence by evaluating incidents and tire behavior in real time.
